race.comment: Strong lean to OOHLALOUVRE (6) off her third in Saturday company at Eagle Farm, beaten just over a length, after winning a BM68 at the Sunny Coast as the odds-on favourite with a bit in reserve. Continues to be a model of consistency for the Bruce camp, who is flying, and only needs to hold her form to be right there again. COUNT NICHOLAS (5) resumes off a plain final run before the break, but his wider 12-month profile is strong and he is a proven track-and-trip performer who handles soft ground. BLITZBURG (1) has been competitive in Open grade at this track at his past two. Backs up quickly and gets an important 2kg claim. EAGLE'S FIRE (8) brings honest CL4 and benchmark form, was second at this venue on soft ground last start, and his repeated track-and-trip placings give him a winning chance.
